verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents APIs to programmatically manage connections, transformations and libraries, and to run Reverse ETL syncs, access audit logs, suppress or delete user data, and pull usage metrics. That is substantial programmatic control, but nothing claims full parity with the UI. The probe found no published OpenAPI spec, and features like Audiences, Tracking Plans, Profiles, Alerts and Live Events show no evidenced API coverage. missing for 10: an explicit UI/API parity statement, documented API coverage for Audiences/Tracking Plans/Alerts/Profiles/Live Events, a published OpenAPI spec, independent corroboration of API completeness.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI

citations.quote: Explore the RudderStack APIs to programmatically manage your RudderStack connections, transformations and other RudderStack features.
